events.title: HK Info Night Online
events.description:
The lights are soft, the spotlight is waiting, and your HK era might be closer than you think. ♡₊˚

Ever wondered what Hoa Khoi Lien Truong (HK) is all about? Whether you’re curious about the experience, what being a contestant involves, or what you can gain from participating, come join us for an HK Info Night!

This opportunity is open to female-identifying members of VSAUW! ♡ Whether you’re considering becoming a contestant or simply want to learn more, come with your questions and a little curiosity. Learn about the show, meet others who are interested, and discover what this experience could look like for you. ✧

✦ INFO NIGHT #1: IN-PERSON
♡ Date: Monday, November 2nd
♡ Time: 6:00–7:00 PM
♡ Location: SAV 168

✦ INFO NIGHT #2: ONLINE
♡ Date: Friday, November 6th
♡ Time: 9:00–10:00 PM
♡ Location: Zoom Link Through LinkTree

Both sessions will cover the same information, so choose whichever works best for you. However, YOU MUST ATTEND ONE INFO SESSION to qualify for HK.

If you’ve been curious about HK, consider this your sign to come learn more. Your next chapter might be waiting in the spotlight. ⋆౨ৎ˚⟡˖

We can’t wait to see you there! ♡

Graphics By: Kaitlyn Liu
#vsauw

events.title: Product Games
events.description:
Get ready for THE PRODUCT GAMES! 🚀🎯🏹

Registration is now OPEN for The Product Games, a one-day product competition combining the strategy of a case competition with the rapid building of a hackathon! 

Work in teams of 4 to tackle a real-world product challenge, build an innovative solution, and pitch your ideas to industry judges! Plus, enjoy free food, swag, mentorship, networking opportunities, and a chance to win prizes! 🏆

Event Details:
📅 Date: Saturday, November 7 | 9 AM – 5:30 PM
📍 Location: Founders Hall, UW
👥 Eligibility: Open to all UW students, regardless of major or experience
🔗 Applications are OPEN NOW, and close October 26 at 11:59 PM

Spots are limited, so don’t miss your chance! Apply through the link in our bio or scan the QR code to register!

events.title: Let’s Talk Drop-in
events.description:
Midterms are here and we see you 👀💜

Here are a few things that actually help: study in short bursts, get some sleep (seriously), and don’t be afraid to ask for help. Swipe for our full survival guide and where to find support at UW.

If things feel heavy, you can talk to someone. Let’s Talk drop-ins are every Tuesday from 2-4 pm right here at the Kelly ECC, and the Husky HelpLine is open 24/7 at 206-616-7777.

And you don’t have to study alone. Come hang out and study with us at the ECC 🦋

Save this for later and send it to a friend who needs it. You’ve got this, Huskies! 🐾

#UWLWB #KellyECC #UWMidterms #HuskyWellbeing #StudyTips

→ See live demos

events.title: Emerald City Card Show by WGA - UW Seattle
events.description:
Emerald City Card Show – UW Seattle presented by the Washington Gaming Association at UW is bringing the ultimate collector experience to the heart of campus! Join us at the UW Husky Union Building (HUB) Ballrooms (2nd Floor) for a full day of buying, selling, trading, and connecting with the PNW community. This is a show built by collectors, for collectors.
Browse 145+ vendor tables featuring Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, sports cards, Riftbound, custom art, handcrafted items, sealed products, slabs, accessories, and more. Whether you’re a student hobbyist, a seasoned collector, or brand new to the game, there’s something for everyone.
What to expect:
Massive Variety: A wide selection of trusted vendors, local artists, and exclusive finds.
Trade-Friendly Environment: Bring your trade binders and find your next grail!
VIP Early Entry: Get in at 10:00 AM — two hours before general admission—to get first dibs on the best inventory and be entered into our raffle for dozens of prizes!
Accessible Location: Located right in the heart of campus in the spacious 2nd Floor Ballrooms.
Location: UW Husky Union Building (HUB)
Room: Ballrooms, 2nd Floor East Stevens Way Northeast, Seattle, WA

events.title: AACF 2027 Winter Retreat
events.description:
AACF 2027 WINTER RETREAT!! ☃️❄️

It’s that time of year to register for our annual AACF winter retreat!! This is an extra special weekend to spend together as a fellowship bonding and deepening our relationships with God. It’ll be a weekend filled with learning from the Word, worship, prayer, deep and meaningful conversations, bonding with the community, and fun activities and games!

Please take note of all this very important information‼️

Time:
January 8-10, 2027 (Arriving Friday evening and returning Sunday afternoon)

Location:
Lake Retreat Camps

Price:
$150 for early bird (by 11/18 at 11:59pm)
$170 for regular (11/19-12/9)

To complete registration, you must submit all 4 of these items (link in bio):
1. Google Form Registration
2. Signed AACF Waiver
3. Signed Lake Retreat Waiver
4. Payment (via AACF form)

ALL payment and forms are due by December 9, 2026‼️

If finances/money is a concern, we offer scholarships! Read the details in the Google Form or reach out to a core member. We don’t want finances to be an issue for attending retreat with us!

events.title: Kindergartners Campus Visit
events.description:
Interested in early childhood education? Want to think critically about when college access begins? Want a chance to build AND facilitate a lesson plan with kindergartners?

EDUC 401 E is coming in WINTER 2027!
Taught by CELE staff, this will be a project-based community-engaged course. Kinders to College is all about designing learning experiences for diverse groups of kindergartners. Federal Way’s kindergartners are coming to campus on Feb 24th…and we’re planning their big visit!

Visit link in bio to RSVP for an info session!
Questions? Email celecenter@uw.edu
